sources.title: Joycent: Diffusion-based Accent TTS without Accented Phone Prediction
sources.snippet: We introduce WhisAID, a Mandarin accent identification model trained on native accented Mandarin speech across multiple accents, and employ gradient reversal layers (GRL) to disentangle accent information from speaker identity.
